summary: Opened a new investigation on the configuration/eligibility axis after re-reading the conf-change paths: propose-time validation decides leave-joint from len(Changes)==0 while applyConfChange decides it from ConfChangeV2.LeaveJoint(), which for an empty change set requires the Auto transition. So an empty ChangeV2 with an explicit transition passes validation while the configuration is joint and is then handled as entering joint, failing with the error config is already joint and panicking. A focused probe on the real FSM confirmed the whole chain: entering joint explicitly gave voters [1 2 3 4] against outgoing [1 2 3]; the empty JointExplicit change reported LeaveJoint false and EnterJoint ok true; stepping it as a MsgProp returned nil and appended EntryConfChangeV2, so validation did not replace it; and applying it panicked with that exact string while still joint. The submission adds the investigation with its discriminator, a behaviour fact, and a fixed experiment (prerequisites plus comparisons on last_type EntryConfChangeV2 and panicked true) so the controller can produce the receipt. No interpretation is included yet because the receipt does not exist; the earlier read-index and membership threads are untouched.
